decisions.reason: A cheap accessory that ties up few resources and supports the core trailer business; slack easily carries it, although its absence from the website since 2020 raises some doubt.
A box trailer line at the heart of the established business that likely still meets aspirations, though trailer series are often renamed or replaced and it has not been observed recently.
A low-bed series close to core competencies with no evidence of falling short of aspiration, so no problemistic search is triggered, despite missing website visibility.
A high-cover series that broadens the core range and fits the firm's production know-how, so it is retained while results stay at aspiration.
A second box trailer series that overlaps with B and is the most likely candidate for range consolidation, but it is kept for now since no clear shortfall has been reported.
